protocol_name: Three-lineage differentiation, interaction and barcoded collection

sizing.capsule_count_note: not in chip spec; sheet default 100,000 used

events.narration: Coat the neural stage-one chamber.
Hold at 37 C until the next scheduled operation. Every lane is incubating independently (ax_mature, mx_mature, nx_mature); the chip acts on one chamber at a time.
Seed iPSCs into the neural lane. The other two lanes are untouched: after this step every lane is fed and drained through its own port, so they never share liquid.
Hold at 37 C until the next scheduled operation. Every lane is incubating independently (ax_mature, mx_mature, nx_mature); the chip acts on one chamber at a time.
No flow while the cells attach.

All three lanes are mature on the same day, which is what the staggered starts were for. Level the volumes across the microgroove arrays: the hydrostatic difference that kept the lanes isolated is removed, so soluble factors, vesicles and axons can now cross. The grooves are not valves and were never closed; isolation was a maintained pressure condition.
Hold at 37 C until the next scheduled operation. Every lane is incubating independently (ax_mature, mx_mature, nx_mature); the chip acts on one chamber at a time.
Cross-talk day 1: feed the neural lane. Feeding each lane separately keeps the exchange going through the grooves rather than through the medium lines.

Hold at 37 C until the next scheduled operation. Every lane is incubating independently (ax_mature, mx_mature, nx_mature); the chip acts on one chamber at a time.
Cool every lane to 4 C. Cold handling limits the activation that warm lifting causes, and stops the lipid-anchored barcodes swapping between cells.
Perfuse barcode_1 into nx_mature. A lipid-anchored oligo inserts into the membrane in minutes with no antibody and no spin, so each lane carries its own label before anything is mixed.
Perfuse barcode_2 into mx_mature. A lipid-anchored oligo inserts into the membrane in minutes with no antibody and no spin, so each lane carries its own label before anything is mixed.
Perfuse barcode_3 into ax_mature. A lipid-anchored oligo inserts into the membrane in minutes with no antibody and no spin, so each lane carries its own label before anything is mixed.
Wash unbound barcode out of nx_mature. Carryover is what causes background, so this is the step that decides whether the labels can be told apart.
Wash unbound barcode out of mx_mature. Carryover is what causes background, so this is the step that decides whether the labels can be told apart.
Wash unbound barcode out of ax_mature. Carryover is what causes background, so this is the step that decides whether the labels can be told apart.
Lift the cells in nx_mature with a gentle, enzyme-free reagent at 4 C.
Lift the cells in mx_mature with a gentle, enzyme-free reagent at 4 C.
Lift the cells in ax_mature with a gentle, enzyme-free reagent at 4 C.
Quench with a carrier-protein buffer so released cells do not stick to the channel walls.
Pool all three lanes. They are safe to mix now because each carries its own barcode: lane identity survives in the sequencing data, and so does any cell that migrated across a barrier.
Wash the pooled suspension twice through the retention mesh to remove clumps.
Deliver one counted, barcoded, filtered suspension to the outlet for encapsulation.
